titleEn: Royal Kram No.0620/022 promulgated the law on the approval of the Kingdom of Cambodia to join the Bern Convention on the protection of literary and performing arts, 1886, and the 1979 amendment

articles.en: The accession of the Kingdom of Cambodia to the Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works, adopted on 9 September 1886 and amended on 28 September 1979, the full text of which is annexed hereto, is hereby approved.

- This Law is declared to be urgent.
Day [illegible], B.E. 2564; done at the Royal Palace, 24 [illegible] 2020. Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, having respectfully reported.
Minister of Culture and Fine Arts, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Bin Chhin.
2/2
